name: teeplug
description: Delegate large reads and file generation to local Claude Code or Codex subscription workers, with project-scoped file memory.

interface.shortDescription: Large-file summaries and generation with CLI workers
interface.longDescription: Keep bulk source and generated files out of the main conversation. Route to the host subscription CLI with configurable worker models and a local summary cache. Optional project-scoped file memory keeps preferences, corrections and verified lessons across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Set up Teeplug for this project.
Use bulk-reader to answer a question about these files.
Use code-writer to generate a file from existing patterns.
Set up project memory and show its status.
